title: The Garden Tour Signs
story: Ten minutes before the tour bus was due, a gust off the harbor flattened every sign on the garden club's June tour and piled them on the sidewalk, red-pencil corrections and all. Four gardens, four flowers, four ornaments, and one garden club president who would rather not admit she has lost track. Can you help Mabel work out whose garden has which flower and which ornament?

texts: Enzo grows either irises or lupines.
Of the owner of the sundial and the owner of the gnome, one grows roses and the other grows peonies.
The gardener who grows roses is neither Gideon nor Pearl.
Gideon has either a birdbath or a gnome.
The owner of the gnome is neither Gideon nor Pearl.

trace.text: Clue 1 limits the choices (mark the X's it gives).
The roses must go with Hattie: clue 4 rules out Gideon and Pearl; clue 1 rules out Enzo.
Clue 5 limits the choices (mark the X's it gives).
Gideon must go with the birdbath: clue 5 rules out the sundial and the trellis; clue 6 rules out the gnome.
Clue 3 limits the choices (mark the X's it gives).
The irises must go with the trellis: clue 3 rules out the sundial and the gnome; the birdbath is already ruled out for Gideon.
The lupines must go with the birdbath: clue 3 rules out the sundial and the gnome; the trellis already goes with the irises.
Gideon goes with the birdbath, so Gideon also goes with the lupines.
Enzo must go with the irises: clue 1 rules out the roses and the peonies; the lupines already goes with Gideon.
Pearl must go with the peonies: clue 4 rules out the roses; the other choices are already taken.
Pearl must go with the sundial: clue 6 rules out the gnome; the trellis is already ruled out for the irises; the birdbath already goes with Gideon.
Hattie must go with the gnome: the trellis is already ruled out for the roses; the other choices are already taken.
Enzo must go with the trellis: the other choices are already taken.
The roses must go with the gnome: clue 3 rules out the trellis; the birdbath and the sundial are already ruled out for Hattie.
The peonies must go with the sundial: clue 3 rules out the birdbath and the trellis; the gnome already goes with the roses.
